entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5937099633141128448 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/v340-ara/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv; cross-identification HIP 82023: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia+DR3+5937099633141128448. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V340 Ara: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3711.8 +/- 242.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 3711.8 +/- 242.3 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2062 +/- 0.0197 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93), 10.5 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -2.781, -6.693 mas/yr. Radial velocity: Gaia DR3 (same row): -77.16 +/- 6.19 km/s.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 99.1 +/- 8.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V340 Ara: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 99.1 +/- 8.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 68,943,870 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5250 +/- 323 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 209, Name='V340 Ara', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5250 +/- 323 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 5937099633141128448: 5 G-band harmonics of a 20.82078991102665 d period, peak-to-peak 0.897 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.06 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,250 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.546 +/- 0.048 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffead9. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,250 K and log g 1 (u1 0.558, u2 0.181): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 1 from 2023A&A...678A.195D, the median of its 10 spectra; the 13 published values span log g 0.6 to 1.8, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.1% of the centre brightness.
